text: Russia has shown footage for the first time of compact Banderol cruise missiles being launched from a Mi 28NM attack helicopter.

Kyiv's mayor says Russian missiles have hit the Ukrainian capital.

The strike comes after Zelenskyy warned overnight that Russia was getting ready to hit energy networks, bridges and other key infrastructure again.
UPDATE: Iran's navy now says the oil tanker fire east of the Strait of Hormuz started after the vessel hit a naval mine.
🚨 Houthis have launched missiles toward Saudi Arabia, according to initial reports.
🚨 Iran's navy reports a fire on a violating oil tanker east of the Strait of Hormuz.
Six U.S. military cargo and aerial refueling aircraft are heading toward Europe on their way to the Middle East.

The Ukrainian soldier rescued in the first ever drone evacuation had spent over 500 days alone on the frontline, cut off from normal rescue, the WSJ reports.

Before he was saved, he had to amputate his own foot to avoid infection.

President Trump gives Stephen Miller a big shoutout: "Most people come and go, but Stephen stayed. He's very loyal."

Trump adds that Miller "knows politics better than anybody."
Trump to a reporter: World War I, World War II, and Russia and Ukraine are wars. With Iran, he says this is not a war. "We are not fighting."
Yemeni government forces have besieged the entrance to al Sarari village in Taiz, cutting off a major Houthi supply line in the province.
Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth: "Patriots in control."
🚨 Multiple explosions have been reported near Isfahan in central Iran, according to initial reports.

Israeli forces have shelled the southern Lebanon village of Bani Haiyyan and carried out a demolition, Lebanese media report.

No casualties have been reported so far.

Iran's IRGC claims its military has reached "complete defence independence", saying it no longer relies on foreign advisers and uses only local expertise.

The claim came from spokesperson Hossein Mohebbi

🚨 Air traffic has halted at Jeddah airport in Saudi Arabia.

Flight tracking shows inbound jets from Riyadh, Muscat, Abha and Bisha circling east of the city instead of landing.

Egyptian FM Badr Abdelatty spoke with Saudi FM Prince Faisal bin Farhan Al Saud by phone.

They agreed to keep working together to prevent escalation, restore calm, and pursue negotiations.
🚨 Two fires have been spotted burning in the waters near the coasts of Qatar and the UAE.
Israeli Air Force fighters are flying over Damascus, the Syrian capital.
The U.S. Embassy in Bahrain has issued a security warning to Americans about a possible airspace closure amid regional developments.

Houthis have released footage of fights against Yemeni government aligned forces across the Kahbub mountain range.

Targets include the National Army, Southern Giants Brigades and Nation's Shield Forces.
